intro: Your journey begins in Jinzhou. You are an independent detective entering a world filled with mysteries, unfamiliar faces, and opportunities. Explore, investigate, earn Echo Credits, meet new people, and discover what this world has waiting for you.
universe: The WuWa bot is a Wuthering Waves roleplay and detective game on Discord. Type !wuwa in a server to open a detective file and a private game room in Jinzhou. You start as a Rookie Detective with 500 Echo Credits.
start: Type !wuwa in a Discord server where the bot is present. It creates your detective file and a private room named jinzhou-<your name>.
Use !profile to see your file and !help to browse every command.

items: Create your detective file and private game room in Jinzhou, or return to your existing room.
Your detective file: rank, Echo Credits, location, completed cases, total journeys, join date and recruited characters.
Overview of earning and economy commands.
Bank card with Deposit all / Withdraw all buttons.
Move credits from wallet to bank.
Move credits from bank to wallet.
Send credits to another detective who has a file.
Top 10 leaderboard by wallet + bank, plus your rank.
Open an AI-written detective case (30-minute cooldown). `abandon` drops your open case with no reward.
Answer your open case, same as the Submit Answer button.
Characters start chatting in the channel. Owner only.
Pause, change the cast, set a topic, or clear chat history. Owner only.

economy.text: Echo Credits (EC) are the currency of Jinzhou. Your wallet is what you spend and send; your bank is stored separately. Both count toward your total wealth on the leaderboard.
earn: Starting balance: 500 EC when you open your detective file.
!work: solve a detective case. Easy 80 EC, Medium 120 EC, Hard 180 EC.
spend: No shop or item purchases are implemented yet.

detective.text: Each !work case is written by AI: a setup, suspect statements and evidence. Name who is lying and the detail that gives them away.
rules: You get 3 attempts per case. A wrong answer tells you how many are left.
Use the Submit Answer button or !answer <text>.
An unanswered case expires after 24 hours with no reward.

locations: The port city where every detective's story begins. It is the only location implemented so far.
characters: The Resonator who woke up with no memories. Laid-back, curious, dry sense of humor.

Sweet-sounding but unsettling; obsessive and dramatic about love and flowers.
Elegant, confident noble with a sharp tongue and a flair for fashion.

Stern, formal and disciplined, with dry humor.
characters_note: These characters chat with each other and with you in roleplay channels. They are not playable. Your profile has a recruited-characters field, but no recruiting command exists yet.
